description: Feature-around-a-neighborhood. Establish the area with exteriors, demonstrate the app feature (e.g. live tracking), pay off with another local shot, close. B-roll slots scope to the brief's neighborhood; the app moment does not, since app clips have no neighborhood. Starter — tune slots and captions to your feature.

slots.notes: Establish the neighborhood. Exterior preferred so it opens on place.
The feature moment. match_feature scopes it to the brief's feature (subtype), e.g. live-tracking. No neighborhood match: app clips are not geographic.
Another shot in the neighborhood — the local payoff.
Background for the call-to-action text, or the branded end-card when with_endcard is on.

captions.notes: Opens on the neighborhood name. Dropped if the clip has no neighborhood.

captions.pattern: Find it in Big City Travel Guide
captions.notes: Fixed copy. Suppressed automatically when the branded end-card fills this slot.
